node.statement: Conditioning and right-inverse identity: because beta_s<1, nu_s is entrywise nonnegative and sum_i nu_s(i)=mu_s(C_s)/(1-beta_s)=1. Pairwise disjointness makes hatA well-defined, and each of its rows is a probability vector. Moreover the s-th row of N hatA is sum_{i in C_s} mu_s(i)e_s/(1-beta_s)=e_s, so N hatA=I_k.
